name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-07-28, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.62 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
